note: DT.1g: the models pass's inputs, read by glia_graph::client_wires. An Angular web client and a gin API exchange invoices and catalog rows over nine routes; every ENDPOINT pairs its ROUTE exactly, every client call site names its response (and the POST / PATCH their request) shape, every handler's 2xx JSON write and JSON bind is a typed server site, and every model carries its declared fields. Names alone would pair wrongly here: the TS Article is the Go CatalogEntry (GET /api/articles writes []models.CatalogEntry), while the Go models.Article of the same name is a stored row that is never serialised; the GET /api/listings envelope carries models.ListingWithSeller, which embeds Listing. The 404 / 400 gin.H bodies are never server sites (skipped by status). engine/tests/model_wire_pairs.rs pins the resolved sides. DT.1h: the models resolver turns the confirmed model pairs into http_model SAME_AS stars, each client model -> the server model it is one with: the TS Listing pairs both models.Listing and models.ListingWithSeller, and ListingWithSeller embeds Listing, so the embedded base is kept; the TS Summary pairs both DailySummary and WeeklySummary (neither embeds the other), so it joins no class. engine/tests/model_identity.rs pins the classes.
